title: Back in Pittsburgh with Hen-Pie
summary: Home around 1927, Roy worked with sax player Hen-Pie and joined Henderson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I worked around there for a while. I think that's when I joined Henderson. Because that was like coming down to '27, you know. Me and my buddy, Hen-Pie, a saxophone player, you know. He was a good tenor saxophone player. Henry Joel(?) or something -- Hen-Pie...
Supposedly, I seem to remember that Tony Perry(?) had some thing of yours when you played with him. That's much later, of course.
Yeah... I don't know where the hell that comes from. Now that I think of it, he was here in New York for a while. Yeah.
